Bang Sue — Krung Thep Aphiwat (SRT land, ph.2 2026-2029)
properties.note: Central terminal + 18 SRT plots under development. Watch: current condo oversupply in the area.

properties.name: Makkasan — HSR 3 airports TOD (pending, ≥2032)
properties.note: 140-rai depot slated for HSR terminal + mixed-use. Contract amendment stalled (caretaker gov.) — a long option, not a commitment.

properties.name: Khlong Toei Port redevelopment (pending, →2035)
properties.note: 2,353 rai, ~100bn THB mixed-use waterfront; zoning upgrade to Por 5 rides on the 2027 city plan.

properties.name: Rama IV corridor — One Bangkok / Dusit Central Park (delivered)
properties.note: Luxury cluster delivered/near-complete: mostly priced in. Rent-side play rather than capital-gain play.

properties.name: Sukhumvit core (Asok–Phrom Phong–Thong Lo–Ekkamai)
properties.note: Main Western & Japanese expat belt: offices, nightlife, intl. supermarkets. Deepest rental demand in town.

properties.name: Silom–Sathon–Lumpini (CBD & embassies)
properties.note: Historic CBD: banks, law firms, embassies, French/European community. Strong corporate-lease demand.

properties.name: Riverside (Charoen Krung–Khlong San)
properties.note: Hotels, Icon Siam, creative district. Lifestyle/retiree expats; premium river-view rentals.

properties.name: Ari
properties.note: Hip cafés/co-working pocket; young professionals and nomads. Small but tight rental market.

properties.name: On Nut–Phra Khanong (budget expat / nomads)
properties.note: Value end of the Sukhumvit line: digital nomads, teachers. High turnover, price-sensitive demand.

properties.name: Rama 9–Ratchada (new CBD, Chinese community)
properties.note: G Tower/Unilever offices, Chinese & Korean communities, embassy of China. Growing white-collar rentals.

properties.name: Nichada Thani / ISB (family compounds, Pak Kret)
properties.note: Gated family-expat enclave around International School Bangkok. Houses more than condos — rent-side reference.

properties.name: Bang Na–Trat corridor (intl schools, Mega Bangna)
properties.note: Berkeley/Bangkok Patana side of town + Mega Bangna. Family demand tied to school run distances.
